solves.reasoning: fullPassage: impact, outnumbered, unaware → ③ impact — outnumbered — unaware
fullPassage: foresaw, lead to, share → ④ foresaw — lead — share
fullPassage: adoption, difference, figure → ② adoption — difference — figure
② greater는 원문 fewer와 반대. fewer job opportunities가 원문
④ two → 원문 three (more than three times the share)
③ half → 원문 twice (more than twice the share)
AI ___ on their job opportunities → adoption. 기술 도입 맥락
fewer 예상자가 more 예상자보다 수적으로 앞섬 → outnumbered
nearly a third ___ little impact → foresaw(예견하다)
opportunities ≈ prospects (기회, 전망)
impact ≈ influence (영향)
workplace ≈ job site (일터, 근무지)
fewer(더 적은) 반의어 → additional(추가적인)
rose(올랐다) 반의어 → declined(하락했다)
(A) this figure = 수치(5%→8%), (B) respected figure = 인물 → 수치 — 인물
새 기술을 사용 시작하는 행위 = adoption(도입/채택)
employ → employed: 과거분사 형용사 (고용된 성인들)
compare → compared: compared to = ~와 비교하여
